svg.text: CWRU and Paderborn only; target data sealed
Gates checked before any confirmatory run
gate G1 passed on both datasets
every arm on CWRU to Paderborn and back
label-blind export to one file, SHA-256 checksum
read only: manifest, array lengths, UORED speed column
every recipe change dated before registration
the speed-column read declared in advance
G1 history and dry-run results kept
corrected speed used in main analysis
stored speed kept as sensitivity run
Throughout: every physical bearing stays on one side of every split, and the code asserts this in every run.
